purpose: Preserve the consolidated Allied-death-tally method while recording the v047 GALVANIC and v048 Bengal scoped corrections and keeping all other event corrections reserved.

trigger.when: At the next consolidated Allied death tally / casualty reconciliation that covers realized 1941-1944 Branch ground combat.
trigger.not_now: v047 and v048 execute scoped exceptions for the reopened GALVANIC Tarawa and Bengal/Arakan nodes. Other realized ground events remain reserved until the consolidated tally trigger.

scope.include: Only realized CURRENT or WORKING-not-promoted ground engagements on the active Branch path through 1944-02-06 18:00 for which Japanese land-combat hardware/process could have affected fire, protection, communications, engineering, vehicles or ammunition reliability.
exclude: ship sinkings and naval personnel losses except where a ground-combat ledger explicitly combines them
purely hypothetical/future or superseded legacy battles
losses already adjudicated with the integrated v047 land layer, including Tarawa and Bengal/Arakan
scope.discovery_rule: At ledger-build time scan the active frontier/current event family, not 99_LEGACY_UNTOUCHED and not stale future handouts. GALVANIC Tarawa is complete under v047 and Bengal/Arakan under v048. Remaining candidates include Makin if a fatality ledger is reconstructed, other active-branch Japanese-vs-Allied ground actions, and 6-Feb Kwajalein/Roi-Namur first-day losses.

event_stage_gates: Was the Japanese weapon/position/vehicle physically present and not already destroyed or suppressed?
Was the target lane preregistered or observed with functioning wire/radio/visual control?
Did ammunition/fuzes, fuel and common vehicle spares survive storage and issue?
Did preparation time/material/engineer plant permit protected positions or obstacles?
Was the fight static/prepared, mobile/jungle, urban, amphibious, pursuit, or collapse/retreat?
Could damaged vehicles be reached and repaired inside the event window?
Were Allied combined-arms suppression, armor, engineers, naval gunfire or artillery strong enough to erase the technical advantage before effective fire?
method.death_vs_total_casualties: Primary accounting target is Allied KIA/deaths. If an old event provides only broad casualties, do not fabricate a fatality split; reconstruct or bound it from event-local evidence.
method.outcome_guard: Default to casualty correction, but change timing/geography if the event-local re-audit proves the old operational state inconsistent. v047 moves Tarawa secure timing by less than one day; v048 moves Chittagong entry about one day earlier. Both captures still occur.
double_count_guards: Do not add hardware uptime as a second soft-C2 bonus when command succession/preregistered fire was already modeled.
Do not add vehicle dispatchability after an event ledger already starts from a Branch-adjusted serviceable count.
Do not add landing-package availability again as weapon lethality after equipment is ashore/in position.
Do not convert artillery prepared-fire bands into a theater-wide casualty scalar.
Do not count fortification survivability twice if the old event already credited dispersed magazines/revetments.
Do not apply mobile-formation 72h reappearance to destroyed/drowned/abandoned atoll vehicles.

hardware_domains_applied: Type 95 running gear/serviceability and atoll-local reappearance
executed_adjustments.Japanese_casualty_consistency: Garrison destruction/near-annihilation remains; the main change is extra combat time and Allied losses, not Japanese evacuation or a new strategic survivor pool.
executed_adjustments.operational_change: Tarawa secure declaration shifts from 11/28 midday center to 11/29 morning center; US capture and naval/air outcomes unchanged.

hardware_domains_applied: artillery/mortar registration and ammunition QC at traced phases
executed_adjustments.Japanese_casualty_consistency: Japanese combat-total center falls from about 6900 to 6300; disease and sea-LOC constraints remain material.
executed_adjustments.operational_change: Chittagong entry shifts from 15 Dec afternoon/evening to late 14 Dec-early 15 Dec, centered late 14 Dec. British demolition and field-army escape still occur.

remaining_reservation.Kwajalein_Roi_Namur_6Feb: Keep the current 430-620 US killed+wounded first-day band plus separate LST-224 personnel loss until the consolidated tally or a separately authorized event rollback. Future fighting after 18:00 loads the integrated land layer immediately.
remaining_reservation.Makin_GALVANIC: No vehicle-driven change identified. A future fatality ledger may still apply non-vehicle land-hardware corrections if event-local data support them.
remaining_reservation.other_active_ground_events: Remain reserved. Do not infer their net number from GALVANIC or Bengal.

expected_direction_not_amount.prepared_amphibious_defense: Usually modest upward Allied ground-death pressure if surviving registered weapons/crews were previously treated at historical technical reliability; can be near zero under overwhelming suppression.
expected_direction_not_amount.burma_bengal_sustained_ground_fighting: Bengal/Arakan is now separately audited and booked; later Burma battles still require their own event ledgers.
expected_direction_not_amount.mobile_or_collapsing_battles: Often small or ambiguous because observation, supply and prepared positions are absent.
expected_direction_not_amount.net_total: UNKNOWN for all remaining events. GALVANIC Tarawa and Bengal/Arakan have separately booked deltas.
